Slayer Guide — Skills, Stats & Gear

Slayer on Global MU Online: The Slayer is a fast melee fighter with short swords. Her damage uses Strength first and Agility second, and her skills hit quickly at close range. This guide lists every Slayer skill, the exact stat formulas, the master skill tree and the full gear ladder from the first set to Imperial, all read from the live server files.

RoleFast melee assassin
Weaponsshort swords
Main statStrength and Agility
Stat points per level5
Master / skill tree points2 per master level
Attack speed cap3,184
On this page: Class line Stats Build Skills Master tree Armour Weapons Wings How to play FAQ

Slayer class line

1st classSlayer→2nd classRoyal Slayer→3rd classMaster Slayer→4th classSlaughterer→5th classRogue Slayer

Class changes are quests: Sebina the Priest and Marlon in Devias for the early ones, and Cent (4th class) and Eunice (5th class) in Lorencia. On X9999 the /evo command does the class change for you.

Slayer stats — what every point does

The Slayer gets 5 stat points per level and 2 skill-tree points per master level. Every stat can go up to 32,700. These are the exact formulas from the server:

WhatFormula
Attack damage(Agility / 20) + (Strength / 9)  to  (Agility / 14) + (Strength / 5)
Wizardry damageEnergy / 9  to  Energy / 4
DefenseAgility / 5
Attack speed / magic speedAgility / 12  /  Agility / 12
  • Damage: Agility/20 + Strength/9 up to Agility/14 + Strength/5, so Strength comes first.
  • Agility gives attack speed (Agility/12) and defense (Agility/5).
  • She plays best when she can stay on one target or a tight pack.

Slayer build — best stats for PvM and PvP

The Slayer gets 5 points per level and your stats are kept when you reset, so a build is mostly about order: first reach the minimum stats below, then spend the rest by the priority of the build you want.

Minimum statValueNeeded for
Agility1,450Demolish skill
Strength354Imperial Short Sword

These are the highest requirements among every skill and the top gear: with them you can learn every skill and wear Imperial. You only need a minimum if you use that skill or item — for example, a build that never casts the skill in the list can skip its Energy minimum.

PvM / farming

Fast short-sword damage

  1. Strength — main damage
  2. Agility — attack speed (Agility/12) and some damage
  3. Vitality — low
  4. Energy — skill requirement only

PvP

Assassin

  1. Strength — main damage
  2. Agility — speed and defense
  3. Vitality — HP
  4. Energy — skill requirement only

Use auto stats to put new points into your main stat automatically after every reset. The formulas above show exactly what each point gives the Slayer.

How to play Slayer on Global MU Online

Levelling

Reset at level 400 with /reset — your stats are kept. Use auto stats to put every new point into Strength and Agility automatically, and check the EXP rates of each realm.

Gear path

Regular sets and weapons first, then the ten mastery tiers from Blood Angel to Lightning, and finally Temple Guard and Imperial. Add a guardian mount, earrings and wings as you go.

Money and help

Earn WCoins and Ruud in-game with the WCoin & Ruud guide, and see the commands list for /offlevel, /offtrade and the other helpers.

FAQ

What is the best Slayer build on Global MU Online?

For PvM: Strength, then Agility, then Vitality. For PvP: Strength, then Agility, then Vitality. First reach the minimum stats (Agility 1,450, Strength 354) to learn every skill and wear the top gear. The Slayer gets 5 stat points per level.

What are the Slayer class names?

Slayer → Royal Slayer → Master Slayer → Slaughterer → Rogue Slayer.

What weapons does the Slayer use?

The Slayer uses short swords. The top weapon is the Imperial Short Sword.

How many skills does the Slayer have?

13 regular skills, 4 4th and 5th class skills and 58 master skill tree skills.

What is the best Slayer armour?

The Imperial Slayer Armor set (legendary, Imperial) is the top Slayer set with 566 defense on the armour piece at +0.

All values on this page are taken directly from the Global MU Online server configuration and are kept up to date with server updates. Renders are taken from the Global MU Online Season 21 client model files.
